mostWorthwhile.text: Adding stretch receptors was most worthwhile because it connected an internal sensor to the familiar experience of positioning an arm with eyes closed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the brain and spinal cord was straightforward, but its result added little explanation beyond naming the central nervous system.

surprise.text: The eyes-closed example clarified that muscle sensors can help guide the arm without sight.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless, though the menu supplied compatible pairs, so I did not have to discover which parts worked together.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in continuing to see how the guided arm acts, especially if later constructions explain more connections between body systems. The repeated single-option choices made this chapter less engaging as a game.
